title: ISS Generator Study
description: Fly between four AI-generated International Space Stations above Earth, compare their topology, disassemble Mint's 158-part build, and step inside the Destiny laboratory.

prompt.objective: Build an orbital viewer for a segmented International Space Station model.

mintAssets.brief: A metre-scaled International Space Station with named modules, solar arrays, and a Destiny lab interior.

experience: Orbit the station above a turning Earth and a fixed starfield.
Toggle wireframe topology and disassemble every part into a catalog grid.
Enter the Destiny lab and drag to look around.
prompt.visualDirection: Mono-type mission telemetry over deep space with cyan wireframes.

thumbnail.alt: The International Space Station with golden solar arrays in orbit beside Earth, framed by mission telemetry and a four-generator model switcher.
